about: Encodes a value as a pattern a camera reads, dark on a light ground in both color modes. The frame is an image with a name, and a download writes the code black on white.

authenticator.about: Two-factor setup: the code contains an `otpauth://` address with its secret, so the frame is named by what a scan does and never by the value. The key under it is for typing by hand.
authenticator.label: QR code to add Stealth Scale to an authenticator app
authenticator.manual: Or type this key into the app:
authenticator.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app.
authenticator.title: Authenticator setup

download.about: `QrCode.DownloadTrigger` renders the library's button and writes the code with its mark as a PNG by default, or as an SVG with `mimeType`. The file is black on white, whatever the palette on screen, and the mark stays centred on the code above the buttons.
download.label: QR code for the pricing page
download.title: Download

effect.about: `glow` puts a halo around the code. `pulse` animates the halo and stops for a reader who asked for less motion.
effect.title: Effects

invite.label: QR code for the invite link

live.about: The value follows a field as a person types, and the frame is named by the address it encodes, which is public here. An empty field renders no code.
live.label: QR code for {{link}}
live.title: Live value

mark.about: A mark over the middle covers modules, so the root raises the error correction to `H`, which recovers up to 30% of the code. The mark renders on the code's light ground.
mark.label: QR code for the Stealth Scale home page
mark.title: With a mark

network.about: A card for a guest network. The code contains the network's password, so the frame is named by the network alone.
network.label: QR code to join the Guest network
network.name: Network: Guest
network.title: Guest network

palette.about: The palette colors the pattern and the mark in the palette's solid, which keeps the contrast a camera needs on the light ground.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: The code's side on the size grid: 64, 80, 128, 160, 192 and 256px, or the width of its container at `full`.
size.title: Sizes

title: QR code
